title: Host-header tenant isolation
summary: Prove Host/X-Forwarded-Host swaps cross tenant data boundaries.
steps: Identify multi-tenant host pattern from map (tenant-a vs tenant-b).
compare_requests same path with Host swapped to sibling tenant.
Include auth cookies from tenant A against Host tenant B.
Require data differential (records/branding/config), not only status.
On PASS: cross-tenant data or admin leakage with evidence.
pass_signals: Tenant B data with Tenant A session/Host
kill_signals: Host ignored or hard-bound to tenant
